newsitem.title: USA: Peoria hog market down $1.50,with top $50.75 - trade.
newsitem.headline: Peoria hog market down $1.50,with top $50.75 - trade.

text.p: Cash hog prices Tuesday in Peoria traded $1.50 per cwt lower, with a top of $50.75, private sources said.
About 600 slaughter hogs were received. Hogs weighing 230 to 260 lbs traded at $50.50 to $50.75; 260 to 280 lbs traded at $48.50 to $50.00.
Sows comprised 15 percent of the run and traded steady to $1.00 lower, with 1-3 300-400 lbs down $1.00 at $42.50,
400-500 lbs steady to down $1.00 at $47.00-$48.00 and 500 to 700 lbs steady to down $1.00 at $50.50 to $52.00.
